suppress.notes: team.unnamed:creative-serializer-minecraft is a Nexo-provided resource serialization library. Dependency-check matches its 1.9.3 library version to Minecraft 1.9.3 and reports Minecraft server/client CVEs that do not apply to this Maven artifact.

CVE-2026-0994 is a Python google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() recursion issue. This project includes the Java protobuf runtime transitively through MySQL Connector/J, so the Python parser vulnerability does not apply to protobuf-java.
